basis: Same original 5-mV external job and matched nominal 75-uA current; finite feedback adds explicit resistor/input-source costs. Larger 20-mV signal is a separately labeled conditional function, with the original THD/gain/swing limits.

resources.boundary: All physical reference, bias, load, feedback and input resistors count. Same ideal Vin/Vdd external ports and source/load impedances, but finite feedback requires input current absorption and later delivery. Signed port power and source/sink peaks are reported separately from the DC positive-delivered-current ceiling. Drawn MOS area excludes passive/layout area and parasitics.

scope: Local DC/AC/current accuracy on the frozen cohort. Nominal noise and separate nominal dynamics. Preselected sparse Local sine conditions; no all-population dynamic pass, manufacturing yield or silicon qualification.
physical_input_freeze: Separate saved-input barrier is required before target exposure.
